head: fe5fb4e

contradictions.title: 14 package artifacts misclassified as evidence
contradictions.description: final-dirty-state.json reports evidence_dirty_count=21, but git status shows 14 workspace/pr-dry-run PDF/PFX files + 7 workspace/verification/latest JSON files. The 14 pr-dry-run files are package artifacts (input PDFs, output PDFs, test.pfx), not evidence. They should be classified separately.

contradictions.title: Cycle 2 executes 6 no-op handlers before detecting idempotency
contradictions.description: planner-loop-ledger.json shows cycle 2 executed all 6 handlers (total_executed=12 across 2 cycles) with 0 changes, then stopped. The fingerprint match was known before execution. Cycle 2 handlers are wasted work.

contradictions.title: Evidence contract proof is aspirational, not actual
contradictions.description: evidence-contract-validation-proof.txt says 'Validation will be run against the final bundle' (future tense). No actual PASS/FAIL result against the ZIP is recorded. The proof describes what the contract checks, not whether the bundle passed.

contradictions.title: PDF recovery packet lacks execution phases and rollback plan
contradictions.description: pdf-conflict-free-recovery-packet.md has exact commands but no phased execution plan, no validation gates between phases, no rollback instructions if a step fails.

contradictions.title: 14 dirty workspace/pr-dry-run binary files have unknown provenance
contradictions.description: git diff --stat shows 14 modified binary files in workspace/pr-dry-run/ but byte sizes are identical (Bin X -> X bytes) for 13 of 14. Only signature/output.pdf changed size (616498 -> 616462). These may be metadata-only changes from PDF library regeneration. Provenance not investigated in Sprint 46.

note: All contradictions are caveats to fix in Sprint 47. None block Sprint 46 verdict.
